name: Lili

queries.query: Lili Wujiang Jiangsu China cadastral parcel map official GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Lili Town (黎里镇) in Wujiang District, Suzhou, and the official Suzhou/Wujiang natural-resources planning context. The results describe planning and mapping programs, but no public parcel polygon download or anonymous parcel query was exposed.

queries.query: 黎里镇 自然资源和规划局 一张图 地籍 地图 苏州 吴江
queries.result: First-party Chinese discovery confirmed that Wujiang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau has a natural-resources/planning 一张图 database and that Lili is covered by official detailed-planning publications. The Jiangsu public land-registration portal exposes registration procedures and city selection, not an open parcel geometry service.

officialSources.observation: Official Suzhou procurement notice says Wujiang's natural-resources/planning 一张图 database covers current, planning, management, and socioeconomic data for internal management and map services. It does not publish a parcel layer or anonymous query endpoint.
Official Wujiang government publication identifies Lili Town detailed-planning units and planning extent; it is planning evidence, not cadastral parcel geometry.
Official Jiangsu one-window land-registration portal provides public registration service navigation and city selection; no parcel geometry or safe parcel-ID API was observed.
Official Suzhou English page confirms the place identity and administrative context for Lili Town of Wujiang District.

requests.outcome: Timed out after approximately 20 seconds with no response bytes; this is an access failure, not evidence of source absence.
Not executed after the preceding public-host request timed out in the same bounded curl attempt; no credentials or certificate bypass was used.
Public page was discoverable and readable; it presented registration service navigation, not an anonymous parcel ID+geometry response.

registryBasis: A local Wujiang/Suzhou natural-resources and planning custodian and an official Jiangsu land-registration service are evidenced. No public local cadastral parcel geometry/API was evidenced, so this is not source integration or admission.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Wujiang/Suzhou natural-resources and planning services cover Lili Town; the public registration portal covers Jiangsu registration services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry response or downloadable safe parcel geometry was obtained.

remainingUncertainty: The official local database may contain cadastral or land-management layers behind internal or restricted systems, but the public pages and bounded requests did not expose one. Exact-point non-hit was not used. No owner, address, titleholder, tax, contact, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
